<observations>
Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers PostgreSQL, TypeScript (strict linting), and capped monthly cloud budget at $1,850.
* 🔴 User deferred recurring invoices until after beta.
* ✅ Fixed null reference error in `src/invoice/pdfGenerator.ts` (15 tests passing).

Date: Mar 14, 2026
* ✅ Implemented Stripe webhook handling (`src/webhooks/stripe.ts`) with exponential backoff (`src/utils/retry.ts`), Winston logging (`LEDGERLY_` prefix), and CI test suite (merged, approved by Alex).

Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 User set public launch date to May 10, 2026 (due to payments audit).
* ✅ Added multi-currency support (EUR, GBP, USD), SendGrid email service (`src/utils/email.ts`), HTML templates, and deployed staging build.

Date: Mar 24, 2026
* ✅ Implemented Google/GitHub OAuth (`src/middleware/auth.ts`), analytics dashboard, CSV export endpoint (`/api/export/csv`), and automated nightly AWS S3 backups.

Date: Mar 28, 2026
* 🔴 Standing rule: Never push directly to main, always open a pull request.
* 🟡 Refactored invoice rendering (`src/services/invoiceRenderer.ts`), added PDF endpoint, Stripe feature flag (`config/featureFlags.ts`), and updated API docs (`docs/api/v2.md`).
* 🔴 User requested monthly revenue breakdown by client tier.
* ✅ Added tiered revenue SQL query (`src/queries/revenueByTier.sql`), dashboard widget, and deployed latest build to staging EC2 instance `ledgerly-stg-01`.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Present the requested monthly revenue breakdown by client tier to the user.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've added the revenue-by-tier query and updated the analytics dashboard. Here is the monthly revenue breakdown by client tier..."
</suggested-response>
